rv.q: Brainiac Live remains an outstanding example of educational theatre.
It truly holds up to its Olivier-winning quality expectations, and is definitely worth catching while it is in the West End this summer.
Brainiac Live! truly does accomplish the extraordinary.
Brainiac Live is energetic, funny and genuinely impressive.
It is a thrilling, high-octane summer treat that makes science unforgettably fun.
This live adaptation successfully captures that same spirit, bringing the controlled chaos and infectious enthusiasm of the television series into the theatre.
‘Brainiac Live’ doesn’t disappoint – bursting with fun, physics and literal fire, it’s a great family show that keeps kids enthralled from start to finish.
Overall, Brainiac Live is a fun filled and stimulating event where the performers seem to be having as good a time as the audience.

cn.t: The Olivier-winning science show delivers explosive experiments and energetic entertainment that educates while it thrills, earning strong reviews for its fast-paced spectacle that engages both kids and adults alike.
